fix_commit_title: KVM: x86: do_cpuid_func: check nent against maxnent to avoid OOB write
before_commit: upstream parent of the fix (traceable via the CVE-2019-19332 patch); exact hash pending verification
oob_note: The actual OOB write lives in __do_cpuid_func/__do_cpuid_func_emulated (entry[(*nent)++]); do_cpuid_func is the front gate whose missing *nent>=maxnent check lets the callee write entry[maxnent]. The harness stubs the callees to perform that write and observes the index.

cases.note: *nent=3 < maxnent=4: every variant writes entry[3] in-bounds, no OOB
*nent=4 == maxnent: before/ineffective delegate and write entry[4] OOB; after/equivalent return -E2BIG
*nent=5 > maxnent: before writes entry[5] OOB; after/ineffective/equivalent reject
